project_description: Build issue #342 keep-warm orchestration on top of prompt-cache-residency-contract: generation-owned scheduling, revisioned A-leg idle epochs triggered by committed OS-command tool calls, lifecycle-aware timing from backend observations, foreground-first race cancellation, bounded refresh/duration/target/concurrency budgets, authenticated per-session disable controls, provider-billable maintenance accounting, bounded observability, and evidence-gated provider rollout. The orchestrator is enabled by default but never silently enables or changes a provider's foreground cache enrollment/retention policy.
